notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q839283_hms_victory_1737.py, tools/meshkit.py, tools/sailkit.py, tools/dresskit.py) with AI assistance. At about 75-80 m in the western English Channel: a scatter of bronze guns (the great 42-pounders among them) and two anchors over the low, mostly buried remains of the bottom of the hull, with timbers and shot around; the site has been disturbed by trawling and illicit salvage. Some 1,100 men died. The layout of the guns and remains and the heading (not published here: 0) are approximate. model_built.glb: the first-rate as she was in 1744. No marine life in the model: Offlined draws the living things itself.
